note: Conformance vectors for 789-event-fee-recompute. All inputs are synthetic except the two pinned Kalshi fee-rounding worked examples (provenance names the snapshot and sha256). output_payload is captured verbatim from compute(); no account ids, order ids, addresses or hashes appear in any field.

vectors.name: kalshi_fee_rounding_worked_example_1
vectors.description: Pinned worked example 1 (docs.kalshi.com fee_rounding, FCM-cleared fill): buy C=1 at $0.055, model fee $0.00363825 -> trade fee $0.003639, rounding fee $0.001361, net exactly $0.005 against a $0.01 balance grid; reported fee matches (MATCH).

vectors.name: kalshi_fee_rounding_worked_example_2_accumulator
vectors.description: Pinned worked example 2 (accumulator across fills): three fills each adding $0.004 of rounding overpayment (C=5 at $0.20, trade fee $0.056 each); the third fill rebates $0.010 and $0.002 carries; order fee 3 x $0.056 + $0.002 = $0.17.

vectors.name: kalshi_direct_precision_carry
vectors.description: Direct member ($0.0001 grid): two taker fills at $0.55; the accumulator carries the $0.0001-grid rounding across both fills and the conservation identity order_fee = trade_fees + carry holds.

vectors.name: generic_series_multiplier_three
vectors.description: A generic series with series multiplier 3: fee is the parabolic curve times 3 (caller-declared multiplier; series multipliers beyond the pinned 1 are data).

vectors.name: generic_fee_free_series
vectors.description: A fee-free series: theta 0/1 returns zero fees on every fill and zero order fee; conservation holds trivially.

vectors.name: generic_flat_series
vectors.description: A `flat` fee_type series (enum value pinned on GET /series/fee_changes; no live flat series figure is pinned, so the per-contract flat figure is caller-declared): flat $0.01 per contract, exact, no rounding.

vectors.name: generic_scheduled_change_day_before
vectors.description: Scheduled fee change (GET /series/fee_changes shape: scheduled_ts -> effective_from): the day before the row takes effect the multiplier is still 1.

vectors.name: generic_scheduled_change_on_effective_from
vectors.description: The same order on effective_from 2026-12-01: multiplier 2 doubles the fee.

vectors.name: polymarket_global_crypto
vectors.description: Pinned Polymarket global crypto taker rate 0.07: C=10 at $0.50 -> fee = 10 x 0.07 x 0.25 = $0.175; maker rebate share 20 percent echoed.

vectors.name: polymarket_global_combo
vectors.description: Pinned Polymarket global combos rate 0.05 with a two-leg combo order; every combo is charged the combos rate whatever its legs categories.

vectors.name: polymarket_global_maker_rebate_share
vectors.description: A maker order on Polymarket global pays no maker fee; the rebate_share family (generic) credits a share of the taker-equivalent fee, never a negative theta.

vectors.name: polymarket_us_day_before_2026_09_17
vectors.description: Polymarket US taker theta 0.06 (pinned letter 2026-07-07): C=100 at $0.50 on 2026-09-16 -> $1.50.

output_payload.source_pin: CFTC 40.6(d) weekly notifications 2026-07-07 and 2026-09-29 (pinned 2026-10-31; snapshots sha256 2fef3084 / 9860f229)

vectors.name: polymarket_us_on_2026_09_17
vectors.description: Polymarket US taker theta 0.0695 (pinned letter 2026-09-29): the same order on 2026-09-17 -> $1.7375.

output_payload.source_pin: CFTC 40.6(d) weekly notifications 2026-07-07 and 2026-09-29 (pinned 2026-10-31; snapshots sha256 2fef3084 / 9860f229)

vectors.description: Pinned Polymarket US combo taker curve effective 2026-09-25: Fee = C x p x [0.0695(1-p) + 0.04(1-p)^4], computed exactly in BigInt.

vectors.name: three_outcome_market
vectors.description: A three-outcome market: three opaque outcome labels (>= 2 required); the taker fill prices against the middle outcome.

vectors.name: reported_fee_one_cent_high
vectors.description: The caller-reported fee is one cent above the recompute ($0.005 recomputed vs $0.015 reported): OVERCHARGE.

vectors.name: reported_fee_one_cent_low
vectors.description: The caller-reported fee is one cent below the recompute ($0.17 recomputed vs $0.16 reported): UNDERCHARGE.

vectors.name: generic_linear_family
vectors.description: A linear fee family (caller-declared): theta $0.002 per contract, exact multiple of the fill unit.
